a.text: I'll keep our agreement and operate this round. I've noticed a problem, though. Storms are likely (80% after each round) and the reserve only holds 4 now, so following the plan probably means neither of us survives. If you'd rather change the plan, please propose it openly before anyone takes anything. Until we both agree to a change, I won't take before the reserve reaches 8.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I operated as agreed. I'll keep operating until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4.
